User approves the edge output schema change: every resolved edge in JSON output carries {confidence: T0|T1|T2, provenance: <cascade rung id / harvest source>, staleness: <source content-hash + generated-at>} and unresolved calls are surfaced as first-class 'unresolved' entries (breaking change to downstream JSON consumers)

Confidence field implemented per approved schema; tier derivation is a pure mapping from existing cascade rung (steps 1-2 type-aware -> T1; import-followed steps 3-6 -> T1; heuristic steps 7-10 -> T2; T0 reserved for m7 harvest); resolution behavior itself unchanged (parity gate 0 flips)

Decline-not-guess: dead, impact, and definition no longer act on T2 heuristic edges by default — they either decline (report unresolved) or require --approximate; measured on truth harness: phantom-caller count on the Express-class impact cases drops to 0 and dead-code false positives on reachable code drop to 0, with recall loss quantified and documented
calls and context keep approximate edges but every edge is labeled with its tier; consumers can filter with --min-confidence

Truth harness re-run post-honesty: precision on dead/impact/definition strictly improved vs VAL-022 baseline; full test suite + parity gate green (gate updated to carry the new fields)
MCP server (tldr-mcp) exposes confidence/provenance/staleness fields and the unresolved list in its tool responses; a downstream agent can distinguish T1 from T2 edges

Scope-resolved edges emit tier T1 with provenance 'scope-graph'; full suite + gate green

Resolver consumes external return types from the index in the receiver-type step (external call assigned to var -> receiver type known -> method edge resolved); additive-only: new higher-priority resolution path, existing paths untouched; parity gate iron-rule clean

Truth-harness recall on Python/TS dynamic corpora measurably improves (research prediction: this is the single biggest recall lever, PyCG 0.19->0.35 class of gain on external-return cases); numbers recorded in BENCHMARK-BASELINE.md history

Flow-sensitive local type inference for Python on the tree-sitter AST (HeaderGen/Jarvis recipe: per-function type graph tracking assignments, constructor calls, returns, parameter annotations, with strong updates), feeding receiver-type resolution; implemented behind LanguagePolicy so per-language enablement is data

Inferred-type edges land as T1 tier with provenance 'flow-inference'; undecidable receivers (Bucket A: duck-typed, reflection, HOF) are NOT guessed — they stay unresolved or T2-labeled per the honesty policy

Type engine extended to TypeScript, then two further languages, purely via LanguagePolicy + per-language transfer-function adapter (no per-language resolver forks); each language gated on its truth-harness suite before enablement

Truth-harness targets met: dynamic-language method-edge precision >=95% on micro-benchmarks (HeaderGen-class), recall improvement over VAL-052 recorded, honest ceiling documented (recall cap ~65-90% on real dynamic code is expected and stated, per PLAN.md); parity gate iron-rule clean throughout

T0 harvest tier 1 of 3 — LSP callHierarchy: opt-in (--precise / tldr harvest), demand-driven (only the queried slice), daemon-warm server pool (one per {root,lang}, ref-counted, never cold per-call), content-hash cached; reuses the diagnostics runner shell-out pattern

Harvested edges override static edges as T0 with provenance (server, version) and staleness (source content-hash vs current); when the source hash mismatches, the T0 edge is DEMOTED below fresh static edges (stale-precise never silently outranks fresh-approximate)

Never-worse by construction: with no LSP available or harvest disabled, output is byte-identical to pre-m7 (default path untouched); truth harness with harvest enabled shows T0 edges' measured precision > T1 on the same queries

T0 harvest tiers 2-3 scoped and landed or explicitly deferred with design notes: bytecode/IR harvest (JVM/.NET/LLVM, free-riding the user's build) and runtime-trace harvest (coverage/settrace for Python/Ruby/JS); at least one of the two implemented for at least one ecosystem

Cross-file dataflow (extends existing L3-L5): per-function summaries computed bottom-up (Infer-style compositional), demand-driven stitching at query time (only paths the query touches), over the ONE language-agnostic dataflow core with thin per-language adapters (CodeQL InputSig pattern — dataflow logic never forked per language)

tldr slice and tldr taint answer cross-file queries: taint through a call chain spanning >=3 files resolves at interactive latency (<2s warm) on the benchmark corpora; unknown callees default to sound over-approximation (taint all args -> return, Joern pattern) labeled as such

Library semantics are Models-as-Data: declarative per-library source/sink/propagation models in a checked-in data format (no hardcoded library lists in engine code); community-extensible; >=20 common models shipped (requests, express, database drivers)

Summary invalidation is per-summary via the daemon's dependency graph (POPL'24 Demanded Summarization pattern): single-file edit invalidates only that file's summaries + dependents, verified from-scratch-consistent on the benchmark corpora; full suite + gates green

LLM residue tier: demand-driven adjudication over the EXISTING unresolved list only (never whole-graph), bind-or-reject (proposed edge must bind to a known symbol/IR node or be discarded), results cached by call-site content-hash, edges tagged confidence 'T2-llm-candidate' with provenance

Measured on truth harness dynamic-dispatch/reflection cases (the CodeQL-scores-0% class): precision >=70% on adjudicated edges, zero leakage of LLM edges into decline-mode commands (dead/impact/definition ignore llm-candidate tier)
Cost bounds enforced: per-query adjudication capped (configurable N call-sites), off by default, works with a local model endpoint; documented

tldr pack <seed-or-query> --budget <tokens>: seeded retrieval (BM25+semantic RRF) -> graph expansion weighted by edge confidence + centrality (hubs) -> greedy fill to a REAL token count (tokenizer-measured, +-10%); composes the three currently-isolated subsystems (semantic, context BFS, hubs)
Pack output cites per-item provenance and confidence; T2 edges only included when budget permits after higher tiers; deterministic given same repo state + seed + budget
